decision.reply_to_employee:
Hi Sara,

Thank you for your claim for the USB-C dock from OfficeHub. Your claim is one of three OfficeHub equipment claims with the same expense date (10 February 2026) that are each under $150 but together come to $423.00. Equipment purchases are measured by the total for a vendor on a day, and a total over $150 needs a manager pre-approval for equipment, which is not on your record. Because of this, I have passed the claim to our Compliance team for review. A finance reviewer will make the final decision. If you have an equipment pre-approval that covers these purchases, please send it to us to help the review.

Finance Operations
decision.escalation_reason: Three same-day OfficeHub claims (C-9101, C-9102, CLM-3005) each under $150 total $423.00 with no pre-approval: possible split purchase.
